problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the municipal budget across 13 infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected community benefit.
The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: projected benefit is 0.180, disruption index is 0.148, allocation bounds [0.079, 0.591]
* Project B: projected benefit is 0.175, disruption index is 0.183, allocation bounds [0.013, 0.563]
* Project C: projected benefit is 0.059, disruption index is 0.118, allocation bounds [0.023, 0.477]
* Project D: projected benefit is 0.040, disruption index is 0.036, allocation bounds [0.098, 0.718]
* Project E: projected benefit is 0.134, disruption index is 0.056, allocation bounds [0.079, 0.414]
* Project F: projected benefit is 0.078, disruption index is 0.037, allocation bounds [0.076, 0.412]
* Project G: projected benefit is 0.050, disruption index is 0.189, allocation bounds [0.081, 0.509]
* Project H: projected benefit is 0.070, disruption index is 0.280, allocation bounds [0.044, 0.739]
* Project I: projected benefit is 0.042, disruption index is 0.299, allocation bounds [0.019, 0.465]
* Project J: projected benefit is 0.162, disruption index is 0.191, allocation bounds [0.069, 0.799]
* Project K: projected benefit is 0.022, disruption index is 0.027, allocation bounds [0.036, 0.849]
* Project L: projected benefit is 0.028, disruption index is 0.197, allocation bounds [0.013, 0.633]
* Project M: projected benefit is 0.161, disruption index is 0.213, allocation bounds [0.090, 0.341]
Each project must receive a portion of the total budget that falls within its specified lower and upper bounds, and the sum of all budget portions must equal the entire budget. To ensure adequate coverage of essential services, the planner requires that the group of critical projects, represented by the subset C = {C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M}, collectively receive at least 0.628 of the total funding. Furthermore, the overall disruption index for the portfolio must not exceed 0.179, and the total projected community benefit must be at least 0.063.
Please determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total projected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
